    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    s = list(map(int, input[n+1:2*n+1]))

    pos = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(p)}
    swaps = []
    cost = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] != s[i]:
            target_pos = pos[s[i]]
            p[i], p[target_pos] = p[target_pos], p[i]
            pos[p[target_pos]] = target_pos
            pos[p[i]] = i
            swaps.append((i + 1, target_pos + 1))
            cost += abs(i - target_pos)

    print(cost)
    print(len(swaps))
    for swap in swaps:
        print(swap[0], swap[1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
